title: fix(plugin-email): a templated email to a named locale folds it against the template's locales and tries the stack's declared fallback before en-US
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8dNy8r76WjFsVdvaSJbXXR)_

Fixes #28880

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the email template locale ladder.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：模板邮件按收件人 locale 精确匹配，失败只再试 `en-US`，所以 `en-GB` 收件人拿不到 `en` 行，`zh-TW` 拿不到 `zh-CN` 行，栈声明的 `i18n.fallbackLocale` 也从不读取，这些投递都以 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` 死信。
- 现在：指定了 locale 的调用依次走：按平台 BCP-47 规则（`resolveBundleLocale`：精确、大小写、基础语言、同语言变体，变体取升序第一个）折叠到模板已有的 locale；再按同样规则试声明的 fallback；再 `en-US`；最后仍是永久失败的 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`。
- 不变：精确命中照旧；不指定 locale 的调用照旧（`en-US`，再取最小 tag），不读声明的 fallback；替换的 `TemplateLoader` 保持原来的精确规则。折叠是内置 loader 的能力，通过模块私有的 symbol 提供，不导出、不加在 `TemplateLoader` 上，公开 d.ts 没有变化。
- spec 里 `SendTemplateInput` 和 `email-template.zod.ts` 的说明文字因此过时，已由 #28896 跟进；本 PR 不改 `packages/spec/**`。

## What changes

All in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/`.

- **`template-loader.ts`**: `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader`'s loader also answers, under a module-private symbol (`TEMPLATE_BUNDLE_LOCALES`, declared in `email-service.ts`, not re-exported from the package index and not a member of `TemplateLoader`), the locale tags the name's bundle carries, de-duplicated and sorted ascending. Its `load` is unchanged and stays exact.
- **`email-service.ts`** (`resolveAndRenderTemplate`): for a call that names a locale over a loader carrying that symbol, it folds the named tag with `resolveBundleLocale` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/system`, no third copy of the ladder), then the declared fallback the same way, loading each resolved tag exactly and skipping a tag already tried; then the existing `en-US` rung. A loader without the symbol, and every no-locale call, take exactly the base path. `EmailService.setTemplateFallbackLocale(read)` stores the fallback reader (the class is not exported, so this is not a published member). The `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` / `TEMPLATE_INACTIVE` messages, the variables check and the envelope columns are untouched.
- **`email-plugin.ts`**: the composition point. `EmailServicePlugin.init` hands the service a reader that resolves the `i18n` service at each send and answers its `getFallbackLocale()` (`i18n.fallbackLocale`, else `defaultLocale`); a host with no i18n service declares none.

The fold is a **built-in-loader capability**: a replacement `TemplateLoader` keeps today's exact ladder, declared fallback included (pinned).

## Tests

- `template-locale-fold.test.ts` (13, the real service over the real registry loader): `en-GB` → `en`; `zh-TW` → `zh-CN`; `zh` → `zh-CN`; `zh-cn` → `zh-CN`; variant expansion takes the first base-language match in ascending tag order in both list orders (`zh-MO` → `zh-CN`); an exact hit wins over every fold; `fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN'` with no match → `zh-CN` before `en-US`; the fallback is folded (`zh` → `zh-CN`); a fallback with no row → `en-US`; no fallback → `en-US`; nothing at all → `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: welcome …`; a no-locale call answers as today and never reads the fallback; a loader without the symbol answers exactly as on base, with a declared fallback (`['en-GB', 'en-US']`, then `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`).
- `template-locale-fold.integration.test.ts` (2, booted `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin`, an app registering the duly shape `en` + `zh-CN` bundle through the `manifest` service, and the real `EmailServicePlugin` with its built-in loader): `en-GB` sends the `en` row and `zh-TW` the `zh-CN` row; with an i18n service declaring `zh-CN`, a `ja` recipient sends the `zh-CN` row.
- **Base vs head** (`origin/main` `b15b634c`): booted send, base throws `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: lf_lead_time (locale=en-GB)` and `(locale=ja)`, head sends `[en]`, `[zh-CN]`, `[zh-CN]`. Unit file on base (with only a no-op `setTemplateFallbackLocale` shimmed in so the file loads): 7 red, the 6 guards green.
- Ablations, each landed on disk then restored:

| rung removed | red |
|---|---|
| fold (exact tag only) | 7 (every fold case, the folded fallback, the booted send) |
| declared fallback | 3 (both fallback cases, the booted fallback send) |
| `en-US` | 3 (fallback-without-row, no-fallback, replacement loader) |
| ascending sort of the loader's tags | 1 (variant order) |
| the loader's symbol | 9 |
| the plugin's i18n wiring | 1 (booted fallback send) |

- `@objectstack/plugin-email` suite: 47 files, 764/764, including the #7731 file that pins the loader's own exact `load` and the service ladder over an exact loader, unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **No published type changes.** `TemplateLoader`, `EmailServiceOptions` and `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader`'s signature are as before; the built `dist/index.d.ts` is identical to base.
- **No-locale ladder unchanged (ruling 2).** The published `SendTemplateInput.locale` doc says a call that omits the locale starts at `en-US`, so the declared fallback stays out of that ladder.
- **Spec docs now stale**: `SendTemplateInput.template` / `.locale` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`) say "no language-subtag folding", and `email-template.zod.ts` says `en-US` is the only rung retried. Follow-up #28896 (domain:spec); not touched here.
- `NotificationTemplateStore`'s own ladder (named, primary subtag, `en`) in `service-messaging` is unchanged (out of scope).

## Verification

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 60 commands on the diff; all 60 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:error-code-provenance`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email typecheck` (runs `check:test-typecheck`): first exit 2 (TS2353, the symbol key on the loader's object literal typed `TemplateLoader`), fixed by typing the local as `TemplateLoader & { [key]: … }`, then exit 0. Scoped eslint over the five changed `.ts` files: exit 0. `pnpm build` of the package: the emitted `dist/index.d.ts` matches base. After the final merge of `main` (`9a9823d9`, nothing under `packages/plugins/plugin-email` or `packages/spec`): the three `template-locale*` files green (38 tests).

The booted send in `template-locale-fold.integration.test.ts` is the order's real `sendTemplate` through the email service with the built-in loader; the duly app itself was not run. Full dogfood not owed (no `!`, no narrowing arm).
